_doc: One entry per painted portrait: file (under src/Souls.Web/wwwroot/Content/Images), size of the shipped image, and the final prompt given to the image model. A prompt is the subject, the race palette, the kind (card, spell or hero) and the style bible of README.md, in that order.
style: Dark-fantasy collectible card game art: a finished painterly digital painting with visible brushwork, rich saturated colour, dramatic rim light that separates the subject from the background, volumetric atmosphere and depth. One single clear subject, large and centred, entirely inside the middle 80% of the frame with nothing important touching the edges; a strong, simple silhouette that still reads at thumbnail size (150 pixels wide); the background is darker and less detailed than the subject. No text, letters, numbers, runes or writing, no logos, no signature, no watermark, no border, frame or card template. An original design that does not resemble any real person or any existing franchise character.

races.frost: Palette and setting: icy cyan, white and steel blue, snowstorm, glaciers and frozen mountain passes, cold rim light.
races.neutral: Palette and setting: cold pale blue, silver and grey, an empty misty void with soft light.

kinds.spell: This is a spell card: the subject is the magical effect itself (its shape, energy and light), not a character portrait. Landscape 3:2 composition (1536x1024).
kinds.hero: Hero portrait: a head-and-shoulders bust facing the viewer, the face in the exact centre of the image with generous space around the head so that it reads inside a circular crop; a simple dark atmospheric background. Square composition (1024x1024).
kinds.mascot: Shop mascots: two full-body characters standing side by side, centred, on a fully transparent background (no scenery, no floor, no frame), with clean painted edges. Landscape 3:2 composition (1536x1024). Charming, friendly and a little comical, in a painterly dark-fantasy card-game style with rich colour and warm rim light. Original character designs that do not resemble any existing mascots, cartoon characters or real people. No text, letters, logos, signature or watermark.
kinds.backdrop: A page background: wide, empty and moody, with no characters and no focal subject, dark and low in contrast so that text and panels can sit on top of it; a finished painterly digital painting. Landscape 16:10 composition (1536x1024). No text, letters, road markings, logos, signature or watermark.
